items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: it was Leadbelly, the same person I was talking to out in the front

ctx.x: And at one time Leadbelly was on the bill. In fact Pete Seeger was the act and I went to work one night and I saw this man standing out in front of the Village Vanguard and I didn't know who it was. And so I struck up a conversation with him and I thought it was just a customer who would come in later. So I had a little dressing room and I went in there and changed my clothes and when I came out I heard this singing and it was Leadbelly, the same person I was talking to out in the front.
